description: ⚠️ Destructive: Force delete rule templates (metrics groups) together with ALL event rules related to them. Pass the groups as returned by ncloud_get_rules_by_metrics_group. This is irreversible.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute force deletion.

groups.description: Metrics groups and their related event rules ([{id, ruleGroupItemDtoList}], from ncloud_get_rules_by_metrics_group)

id.description: Monitor group or metrics group ID to delete

ruleGroupItemDtoList.description: Event Rules related to the group (RuleGroupItemDto[], as returned by ncloud_get_rules_by_metrics_group / ncloud_get_rules_by_monitor_group)

name: ncloud_delete_metrics_group_force
